# **📄 Pull Request Template (PR Template)**

```markdown
# 📝 Pull Request Title
<!-- 
Use a clear, descriptive title.
Example: "Add Sustainability Insights Section" or "Fix mobile layout for Product Grid".
-->

---

## 📌 Summary
<!-- 
Explain WHAT this PR does in 2–3 sentences.
Focus on the change, not the history.
Example:
- Adds the Sustainability Insights section with animations.
- Fixes layout issues on mobile for the product grid.
-->

---

## 🎯 Purpose / Why This Change Is Needed
<!-- 
Explain WHY this change exists.
This helps reviewers understand context and prevents back‑and‑forth.
Example:
- Required for homepage completion.
- Fixes a bug reported in Issue #12.
- Improves SEO performance.
-->

---

## 🔍 Related Issues / Tickets
<!-- 
Link issues using GitHub syntax:
Closes #12
Fixes #8
Relates to #5
-->

---

## 🧩 Changes Included in This PR
<!-- 
List the key changes. Keep it crisp.
Example:
- Added new `SustainabilitySection` component.
- Updated Tailwind config for custom colors.
- Refactored layout for better responsiveness.
-->

---

## 🖼️ Screenshots / Visual Proof (If Applicable)
<!-- 
Add before/after screenshots, GIFs, or screen recordings.
This is extremely helpful for UI/UX changes.
-->

---

## 🧪 How to Test This PR
<!-- 
Provide exact steps to test.
Example:
1. Pull the branch.
2. Run `npm install`.
3. Visit `/sustainability` page.
4. Verify animations load correctly.
-->

---

## ✔️ Checklist
<!-- 
Ensure all items are completed before requesting review.
-->
- [ ] Code follows project coding standards  
- [ ] No unused imports / console logs  
- [ ] Mobile & desktop tested  
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed (alt text, labels, contrast)  
- [ ] All tests passing (if applicable)  
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, comments, etc.)  

---

## 📦 Breaking Changes (If Any)
<!-- 
Describe anything that may break existing functionality.
If none, write: "None".
-->

---

## 🧠 Additional Notes
<!-- 
Add any extra context reviewers should know.
Example:
- "This is a temporary fix; a full refactor is planned."
- "API response structure changed; update your mocks."
-->
```

---

# **Why this template works**
### **1. Clear reviewer expectations**
Each section tells contributors *exactly* what to provide — no ambiguity.

### **2. Encourages good engineering habits**
- Testing steps  
- Screenshots  
- Breaking change awareness  
- Linking issues  

### **3. Scales for solo or team workflows**
Even if you're the only contributor, this keeps your PRs structured and searchable.

### **4. Matches modern GitHub standards**
This format aligns with templates used in top open‑source projects.
